##### Project general facts

Anwa Aria is a seafront retreat poised on the shores of the peninsula, offering meticulously crafted residences from studios and apartments to breathtaking penthouses and seafront townhouses. Each residence offers breathtaking sea views and is complemented by thoughtfully curated amenities, enhancing a unique lifestyle where residents can enjoy the infinite horizon of Dubai. Select homes boast a clear sight of the iconic Burj Khalifa, creating a glittering jewel in the Dubai skyline that elevates every perspective.

The development serves as a gateway for a life less ordinary, with an exclusive cruise destination just moments away along the waterfront promenade offering a myriad of retail, dining, and entertainment experiences. Residents can bask on the beach, discover the floating yacht club, or savour a variety of culinary options all at their fingertips. The podium duplexes feature private gardens and grand terraces, while the exclusive penthouses offer expansive living spaces, high-end finishes, and private access with an exclusive vantage point across Dubai.

Each residence features marble and ash wood throughout living areas, creating a sense of calm and sophistication that echoes the maritime landscape. Large windows and balconies are positioned to overlook the sea, flooding every residence with natural light and spectacular views, while bathrooms feature a thoughtful combination of marble, quartz, and porcelain balanced with sleek accessories. The lavish lobby with marble finishes, high ceilings, and plush seating sets the tone for exceptional living, while each home combines indoor comfort with the freedom of waterside living.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated in Dubai Maritime City, an ingeniously designed peninsula that artfully blends urban living with a peaceful waterside setting. The community is a beacon of nautical charm, glittering between city landmarks and the expanse of the Arabian Gulf. The neighborhood's unique character creates a distinctive atmosphere that sets it apart from other areas of Dubai.

The location offers effortless connectivity to Jumeirah Beach coastline, Dubai International Airport, prestigious schools, state-of-the-art hospitals, and major landmarks including Dubai Mall and Dubai International Financial Centre. The area's strategic positioning ensures that residents can enjoy both the tranquility of waterfront living and convenient access to the city's vibrant attractions. The community's thoughtful design provides a perfect balance of seclusion and accessibility.

The neighborhood's waterfront promenade offers a myriad of retail, dining, and entertainment experiences that cater to every lifestyle need. The exclusive cruise destination and floating yacht club add to the area's appeal as a premier waterfront destination. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of nautical charm, strategic connectivity, and urban convenience, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most unique and desirable communities.
